melodicFingerprints: Cell A–C#–B–E–F#. Heard at the opening, at the tempo change, inside the fast section, and at the return.
protectedLandmarks: Rehearsal A@1, B@9, C@22, D@33, E@55, F@65
blueprint.originalBassIdentity: Upright-bass event stream of leadsheet V1.1. CBV is no-change. The V1.3 performance score keeps that stream.
strongestPassages: Performance Edition V1.3 is the checked score. A–H are inventoried, and E is E-V3.0. Passages are not spliced. This revision does not add a listening rank.
blueprint.harmonicJourney: Open fifth, then counterpoint, then the tritone and pentatonic collision, then the line made from the cell, then common-tone dyads from bar 33, then the E/A freeze, then the return.
blueprint.contrapuntalOpportunities: The second voice enters late in bars 9–18 and leaves. That writing is already in V1.3.
blueprint.dramaticClimax: Bars 46–64 in the V1.3 plan: splinter, empty bar, chordal cell, failed reassembly, freeze, bass lead.
blueprint.thematicReturn: Bars 65–72. The cell returns. F# is refused as a long note. The one recorded refinement replaced an immediate C#–B restatement at bar 67 with a rest, then the B chord.
blueprint.expectedPerformanceDuration: Sound tempo 58, then 84 from bar 33, then 58 from bar 65. Checked playback 4:17.30.

mci.continuity: The cell A–C#–B–E–F# stays recognisable at the opening, the tempo change, the fast section, and the return. The bass event stream, metre, rehearsal marks, protected guitar silences, and the final F# stay.
mci.innovation: Guitar writing changes only where this song needs a join: the wrong universe into the new tune, the hinge, the splinter, and the B chord after silence. A–H are read for ideas. Whole passages are not pasted.
